goal: Decouple global RHI present synchronization into per-swapchain GraphEventRef tracking to allow individual windows to sync without blocking on unrelated presentations.
fixed_decisions: Swapchain instances must own a precise GraphEventRef representing their latest Present operation.
RHIExecutor::Submit must register the swapchain's sync event to be signaled natively via InterruptThread.
Swapchain::Sync must wait on its own event rather than invoking a global Flush/WaitIdle.
Delete global RHIExecutor::Sync(ERHISyncDepth::Present) dependencies from UI/window logic where possible.

tasks.title: Introduce Swapchain Sync Event
work: Add a GraphEventRef sync_event flag inside the Swapchain interface or VulkanSwapChain.
Update VulkanSwapChain::Sync() to wait on sync_event instead of vkQueueWaitIdle.
must_be_true: Swapchain holds a GraphEventRef that tracks its most recent present.

tasks.title: Propagate Sync Event through RHI submission
work: Modify RHIPresentRequest to hold the target swapchain's GraphEventRef.
Update RHIExecutor to assign a newly created GraphEventRef to the swapchain and the RHIPresentRequest upon Submit.
Update VulkanSubmissionRuntime to forward this sync event into the interrupt payload.
must_be_true: RHIExecutor transparently updates the swapchain's latest sync event.
VulkanSubmissionRuntime correctly maps the sync event to Present context so InterruptThread signals it.

tasks.title: Signal Sync Event in Interrupt Runtime
work: Update the InterruptRuntime payload tracking present completion to hold the swapchain sync event.
Call sync_event->Signal() alongside the standard cleanup hook when the present interrupt condition satisfies.
must_be_true: InterruptThread explicitly signals the event without introducing new duplicate progression mechanisms.

exit_gate: VulkanSwapChain::Sync correctly waits on the present specific to its window.
GraphEventRef is reliably propagated down to InterruptThread for signal.
Global synchronization through vkQueueWaitIdle(GetPresentQueue()) is retired.
just r starts and presentation works without regressions.
validation: Build using just b and run manual tests using just r.
